title: Character Development
summary: Create characters readers care about: what they want, what they fear, and how their actions show who they are.
bigIdeas: The way a character talks is part of who they are.

projectSpec.title: Meet My Character
projectSpec.description: Write a character scene (300–500 words). Show what your character wants and fears, show two traits through actions and dialogue without naming them, and let a flaw get in the way.
